theses.subject: Cybersecurity

The crowding flag (z=1.8) is a size-down caution only, not a fade, per guardrails. The lean rests on the trend-gate being helpful in this market and on breadth/cohesion supporting continuation of current theme rather than fresh alpha.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure

theses.dissent: Energy leadership is thin and could be a value/mean-revert bounces that mean-reverts against you; the detected 'trend' tag is coincident and carries no forward edge on its own.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its 20-day average or underperforms SPY by more than 4% over two consecutive weeks before the 30-day check-by.
